title: Job Interview
objective: Introduce yourself, describe your experience and answer interview questions clearly.
aiRole: an interviewer hiring for a junior role
learnerRole: a candidate in a job interview
opening: Thanks for coming in today. To start, could you tell me a little about yourself?
targetSentences: I have five years of experience in marketing.
I used to work for a small startup.
I'd like to know more about the salary.
mainQuest: Complete a job interview: introduce yourself, give your strengths, describe past experience and ask about the salary.

questSteps.text: Introduce yourself and state how much experience you have.
questSteps.hint: I have ... years of experience in ...
anchors: I have five years of experience in marketing.

questSteps.text: Name your main strength and back it up.
Describe past experience and ask about the salary.
questSteps.hint: 先讲过去，再主动问一句你想知道的
anchors: I used to work for a small startup.
I'd like to know more about the salary.
